blocks.tamil_translation: By time - surely man is in loss, except those who (with monotheistic) faith believe, do good deeds, and counsel one another with the truth, and counsel one another with patience!

blocks.text:
Note:- This Surah gives us very great guidance: just as it is very important for a person to shape his own deeds on the basis of the Qur'an and Hadith, in the same way he must strive fully to call other Muslims towards Iman and good deeds. If he does not strive in that way, his own good deeds alone will not suffice for attaining salvation. In particular, turning a blind eye to the evil deeds of his relatives and kin, his friends and those connected with him will be an obstacle to his success. However many good deeds he may be doing with care, it is still so! That is why enjoining good and forbidding evil has been made obligatory upon every Muslim through the Qur'an and Hadith. In this matter both the common people and the prominent ones among the Muslims are negligent. May Allah Ta'ala grant all of us the ability to act in the way this ayah has shown! Ameen.
(Ma'ariful Qur'an)

blocks.arabic_text: وَقَالَ تَعَالى: (كُنْتُمْ خَيْرَ أُمَّةٍ أُخْرِجَتْ لِلنَّاسِ تَأْمُرُونَ بِالْمَعْرُوفِ وَتَنْهَوْنَ عَنِ الْمُنْكَرِ وَتُؤْمِنُونَ بِاللهِ۞).
blocks.tamil_translation: You are the best community brought forth for mankind; (because) you enjoin good; you forbid evil; and you believe in Allah.

blocks.text: Explanation:- O Muslims, Allah Ta'ala has made you the best Ummah above the other Ummahs
